description: In this course, students read core theories of translation and translators' reflections, assess existing translations of well-known German works, and create their own translations, collectively and individually, from a variety of text genres, including literary prose, poetry, film subtitling and essays. There is space for students to pursue their own topic interests and hone advanced German skills through reflective and analytical writing and presentations. Taught in German. Prerequisite: At least one 250-level GERM course or with instructor permission.
fullname: Topics in Literary Analysis: Meaning and Form
